title: Solar System
definition: The gravitational bound system comprising the Sun and the objects that orbit it, formed approximately 4.6 billion years ago from the gravitational collapse of a giant interstellar molecular cloud.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims (GS-1) regarding planetary characteristics, astronomical definitions, asteroid belts, and space missions, while forming the foundational backdrop for geomorphology and climatology in Mains GS-1.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Solar System formation and dynamics.
Evaluate spatial distribution, planetary classifications, and space exploration missions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of gravity, stellar evolution, and cosmic scales
